meta.description: Read published Google booking-page availability without calendar authentication. Portable MCP and text/JSON CLI with explicit date coverage.
meta.author: RUDI
meta.boundary: Public Google appointment pages only. Isolated unsigned-in browser; no cookies imported, sign-in, calendar API credentials, time-slot selection, reservation, booking or messages. Other providers and custom domains are unsupported. Dates and times are provider evidence, not reconstructed calendar availability.
meta.browserSetup: After package installation run npm run install-browser in the stack directory. Browser binaries are machine-local dependencies and are not bundled or synchronized.
